title: Wolff Cone-Decomposition and Local-Smoothing Conjectures
exact_target: For functions $f_k$ whose Fourier supports lie in $\delta$-plates of the truncated light cone in $\mathbb{R}^{d+1}$, does $\lVert\sum_k f_k\rVert_p\leq C_\varepsilon\delta^{-\alpha(p)-\varepsilon}(\sum_k\lVert f_k\rVert_p^p)^{1/p}$ hold for $p>2(d+1)/(d-1)$, where $\alpha(p)=d(1/2-1/p)-1/2$? Does the stronger mixed-norm version with $(\sum_k\lVert f_k\rVert_p^2)^{1/2}$ and exponent $\beta(p)=(d-1)/4-(d+1)/(2p)$ hold for $p>2+4/(d-1)$? Do the associated Sogge local-smoothing and cone-multiplier estimates hold in their conjectured ranges?
